typed_core.name: uad_version

nested_lists.name: comparable_sales
nested_lists.shape_reason: 3-6 comps; the SUMMARY ROW per comp only — the full adjustment grid is ~25 lines per comp (~150 values) and would risk the 16,384-token ceiling

fields.name: net_adjustment
fields.why: FR-2 — large adjustments are an inflated-value signal

rejected.name: appraisal_delivery_date
rejected.reason: BOUNDARY ERROR — DC-6's date lives on the Appraisal Delivery record, a DIFFERENT document type. It is not on the appraisal report

rejected.name: the full adjustment grid (~25 lines x 6 comps)
rejected.reason: token ceiling — the summary row per comp serves every rule that reads comps; no rule reads an individual adjustment line

rejected.name: is_value_supported / value_is_reasonable
rejected.reason: a judgment, not a fact — PR-2 compares to the contract price. Tags describe; rules judge

rejected.name: is_fha_eligible
rejected.reason: a judgment — PE-4 applies the FHA rules to the deficiencies

rejected.name: neighborhood_description / market_trend_narrative
rejected.reason: prose; no rule reads it. Catch-all

rejected.name: cost_approach_detail
rejected.reason: only the value approach USED matters (PR-4)

encoding_variations: UAD 2.6 vs 3.6 — the dominant variation. Different form numbers, field names and rating vocabularies; cutover ~Nov 2026
Form type changes the layout entirely: 1004 (SFR) / 1073 (condo) / 1025 (2-4 unit) / 2055 (exterior-only)
Condition is C1-C6 in UAD, but legacy reports use prose ('average', 'good')
Adjustments may be a grid or a narrative
HOA dues may be monthly or annual

open_questions.q: UAD 3.6 cutover (~Nov 2026) — build for 2.6 now, or design both?
options: version-agnostic schema, branch only in the prompt
open_questions.recommendation: version-agnostic schema with prompt branching — the field NAMES are stable enough; it is the LOCATIONS and vocabularies that move
summary row — no rule (PR-2/PR-4/FR-2) reads an individual adjustment line, and the grid is ~150 values

open_questions.q: One schema with form_type branching, or separate document types per form?
open_questions.recommendation: one schema — the rules read the same fields regardless of form

open_questions.q: PR-8 needs FEMA disaster declarations cross-referenced against county and date
options: out of scope for the schema
open_questions.recommendation: out of scope — this is EXTERNAL REFERENCE DATA, the same class as PE-1's FHFA table. The schema's job is to supply county and effective_date

notes: NO v2 catalog entry — the rule floor IS the entire schema.
THE MOST TIME-SENSITIVE DOCUMENT IN THE SET: the UAD 2.6 to 3.6 cutover is ~Nov 2026, and the two versions have different field sets. Building after the cutover means supporting both formats anyway.
appraisal_delivery_date was placed on this document in an earlier draft — corrected here; DC-6 reads a separate Appraisal Delivery record.
